item_summary: $80-100 low-profile wireless mechanical keyboard with tactile switches and multi-device Bluetooth support
detailed_item_draft: Identify a low-profile wireless mechanical keyboard within the $80 to $100 USD price range. The unit must utilize tactile mechanical switches specifically designed for low-profile actuation (e.g., Kailh Choc Brown or equivalent) to provide a distinct tactile bump without noise. Connectivity must include Bluetooth 5.0 or higher with multi-device pairing support for at least three devices, featuring hardware-based switching. Battery performance should support a minimum of 30 hours of continuous use with backlighting enabled. A detachable USB-C cable for charging and wired mode is required. Keycaps must be double-shot ABS or PBT. Layout should be compact (65% to 75%) with a rigid chassis to prevent flex. Compatibility must include Windows, macOS, and Android. Preferred features include customizable RGB or white backlighting and onboard memory for macro storage.
